verdict.rationale: A national company registry with an online filing portal can fairly be asked how its sign-in works, so the axis applies. The only evidence is two robots.txt HTTP 403 probes, which say nothing about the published sign-in path: no evidence shows remote credential MFA, and none rules out biometric liveness, in-person verification or a mailed PIN.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
